## Situation

Personal roll, shared roll, multiple bathrooms, travel, guests, roll-size change, or another context? Share examples without identifiable bathroom logs.

## Decision to make

Should we keep an interval-only physical clock, add an explicit household/personal mode, or normalize consumption? Describe the user benefit and the data each option needs.

## Observation vs assumption

What is actually measured? What is inferred? Why would any per-person division be valid? What happens when household composition changes?

## Alternatives and tradeoffs

Consider privacy, effort, missing data, uncertainty, and whether more precision improves reflection.

## Proposed acceptance criteria / sources / open questions

Record the decision, units, language, migration behavior, and tests for edge cases before implementation.
